newsitem.title: SPAIN: Apr trade deficit confirms Spanish recovery-Ecomin.
newsitem.headline: Apr trade deficit confirms Spanish recovery-Ecomin.

text.p: Spanish April trade deficit data reflect a pick-up in internal demand, the Economy Ministry said on Thursday.
Despite a strong seasonal factor, "April data are really high and reflect the speeding up of internal demand and the activity in the latest months," a statement said.

"Exports are coherent with April Industrial production index, and more in general, with improved confidence of the sector shown in the latest report on the economy by the Industry and Energy Ministry".
Earlier on Thursday, the Economy Ministry said that the April trade deficit stood at 278.7 billion pesetas, 13.6 percent higher than April 1996.
In particular exports rose to 1,357.1 billion pesetas versus 1,097.1 in April 1996, and import to 1,635.8 versus 1.342.4.
